_doc: One market per listed token per New York trading session (see open-markets.mjs). A stock can trade on Solana as several tokens from different issuers (xStocks, Backpack Securities, Ondo Global Markets); each token gets its own pool, since the tokens are not interchangeable. All pools of a stock share the stock's thresholds and resolve on the same official close. thresholdsBps are chosen near the quartiles of the stock's daily moves (TSLA/NVDA/SPY: 12 weeks to 2026-09-11 from Alpaca SIP; SPCX: all 63 sessions since listing, Yahoo) with the middle cut at 0, so the four ranges read big drop / small drop / small gain / big gain. On-chain thresholds are in ppm (bps x 100). seed = fee-free prize in shares of that token; profile = which issuer's Token-2022 extension set the devnet mock copies.
